title: xtract_stats
description: Quantitative evaluation tool of XTRACT results in neuroimaging

folder_basename.description: Path to microstructure folder and basename of data (e.g. /home/DTI/dti_)
folder_basename.title: Folder Basename

xtract2diff.description: EITHER XTRACT results to diffusion space transform OR 'native' if tracts are already in diffusion space
xtract2diff.title: Xtract to Diffusion Transform

reference_image.description: If not 'native', provide reference image in diffusion space (e.g. /home/DTI/dti_FA)
reference_image.title: Reference Image

structures_file.description: Structures file (as in XTRACT) (Default is all tracts under <XTRACT_dir>)
structures_file.title: Structures File

threshold.description: Threshold applied to tract probability map (default = 0.001 = 0.1%)
threshold.title: Threshold

measurements.description: Comma separated list of features to extract (Default = vol,prob,length,FA,MD - assumes DTI folder has been provided). vol = tract volume, prob = tract probability, length = tract length. Additional metrics must follow file naming conventions. e.g. for dti_L1 use 'L1'
measurements.title: Measurements
